description: Requested coverage, not installed safety guidance. Editorial topic labels derived from the owner's handwritten image; spelling normalized. This is not a verbatim transcript. Uncertain handwriting remains marked. No original photo or private conversation is distributed. Later editorial topics are explicitly marked with their own origin and are not attributed to the handwritten image.

topics.title: Vehicle repair and maintenance
topics.coverage_scope: Historical vehicle-specific gasoline-engine overhaul reference for Willys MB/Ford GPW; not modern all-vehicle repair. Written for trained ordnance-maintenance personnel. Obsolete practices, materials and OCR errors remain unchanged. No qualified mechanical safety review. Never transfer its dimensions or torques to a different engine. Covers historical engine removal, disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, installation and clutch service only. No modern engine, electronic, brake or complete vehicle-maintenance coverage.

topics.title: Linux and ethical cybersecurity tools
Possible AI-assisted cybersecurity tool; handwritten wording needs confirmation
Physical and digital locks / authorized access recovery
Foods to keep and shelf-stable foods to acquire
topics.coverage_scope: Catalog scope only: USDA food-storage chapter, including shelf-stable food and its associated warnings. Not a complete food-stockpiling, home-canning, nutrition or dietary-needs manual. Edition March 2015; currency not certified.

topics.title: Building antennas and understanding useful radio types
topics.coverage_scope: Illustrated 902–928 MHz monopole measurement/construction case plus antenna theory; separate 915 MHz US Meshtastic Yagi assembly, purchasing BOM and element-preparation supplement. Not GMRS, VHF/UHF or broadcast-FM build coverage and not a complete kit: GCARC fabrication models and measurement hardware are absent. No RF performance, regulatory or safety certification.

topics.coverage_scope: Generator hazard reference only. Solar setup, PV component selection, battery storage design, wiring, sizing and equipment-specific installation remain unfilled; no DIY installation procedure supplied.

What water is suitable to drink
topics.coverage_scope: Limited CDC emergency/backcountry treatment comparisons and EPA emergency-source, private-well assessment/testing references. Not proof a source is potable, comprehensive chemical analysis, or certified system design. Historical source editions and unverified extraction caveats remain.

topics.title: Staying sanitary
topics.coverage_scope: Limited CDC hygiene plus CERT public-health sanitation/disaster-waste references. Not comprehensive sewage engineering, municipal waste management or validated infection-control guidance.

topics.title: Finding water
topics.coverage_scope: Limited EPA emergency-source discussion and post-flood private-well inspection/testing references. No geographic water-finding, well drilling, field-source guarantee or mapping-to-potability claim.

topics.title: Filtering water
topics.coverage_scope: Historical CDC pathogen/treatment comparison sheet, including filter limitations and source warnings. Not chemical-contaminant testing, equipment selection certification or a complete treatment-system manual. Also CAWST September 2009 Version 10.0 concrete biosand construction/operation/maintenance, including construction safety and disinfection limitations. Historical, training-dependent design; not certified potability, chemical-contaminant treatment or a universal filter.

topics.coverage_scope: CERT disaster medical operations Units 3 and 4 in the complete participant manual. Designed for a course with hands-on practice; not a standalone CPR certification, comprehensive first-aid manual or clinical-care substitute.

topics.origin: Editorial label for the explicit replacement-list request and this admission; not attributed to the older handwritten image.
